scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Dart Flutter client (pyric_crashlytics) conforming to firebase_crashlytics via the Pyric WebSocket bridge and CrashlyticsBroker. Covers per-app FirebaseCrashlytics.instance and instanceFor isolation, setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled overrides, log and setUserIdentifier, setCustomKey and setCustomKeysAndValues with null deletion, recordError and recordFlutterError / recordFlutterFatalError DiagnosticsNode extraction, simulated crash() and didCrashOnPreviousExecution, unsent report queues, flush and fetchAppState, and RS256 App Check token attachment.
